purpose: lists each open change's reviews and checks, and the changes merged last

--text.description: prints the stages as text, even on a terminal

--json.description: the stages as one JSON object: stages, then each stage's document under its name, null for one that could not be read

--jq.description: the same JSON, formatted by jq for a person

--stages.description: prints the stages, one per line, in order, the same over any workspace

--marks.description: prints a mark per stage, as one JSON object, which changes when what the stage draws does: for each, the forge's own marks of its issues, which move with its changes, and of its runs

--fresh.description: reviews and checks read the open changes afresh, not the snapshot of the last minute

reviews.description: {change, title, login, state, at, unresolved}, keyed by the change's number and the login: state is requested while the reviewer is asked and has not answered, else approved, changes, or commented; at is when they answered, in seconds since the epoch, null while asked and on Azure DevOps, whose votes have no time; unresolved counts the change's unresolved threads. The author's own comments are no review

checks.description: {change, title, name, verdict, at, took}, keyed by the change's number and the check's name: verdict is passed, failed, or pending; at is when the run started, in seconds since the epoch, or null; took is how long it ran, in seconds, null while it runs. A forge whose provider lacks check-runs, as one written to a contract before 4, has no runs on its changes: the document has no rows, and {feature: check-runs, off: true, lacked: true} under errors

merged.description: {number, title, author, branch, merged, by}, keyed by its number: merged is when, in seconds since the epoch, and by who merged it; the title links to its page. Where the forge holds more, the document is limited, at how many it drew: a forge that lists them by update, as GitHub does, keeps only those merged since the oldest update it read, as one merged before may be missing

changes.description: a tab kit flow prints; on a terminal it opens in kittui, and with a form it is refused
